Sidebar Surface Parity

Praxis Desktop · theme.css

The surface pack and theme now land on the left panel

.pane-sidebar composited the surface-pack material over --bg-sunken, the darkest token in every palette. On that near-black base the soft-light / overlay grain and the accent glow all but vanished — so a pack read strong on the centre and right panes and flat on the left. Fix: composite over --bg, the same base .pane-aux uses, plus isolation: isolate for parity. The rail still sits below the editor’s --bg-elevated.

- background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-sunken) calc(var(--surface-panel-opacity) * 100%), transparent); + isolation: isolate; + background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) calc(var(--surface-panel-opacity) * 100%), transparent);

Before / after — sidebar crop

Parchment pack · Praxis Dark theme · same launch, same frame

Across packs and themes

full shell — the material and palette run continuously from the left panel through the centre and right panes

Screenshots captured by a throwaway Playwright spec against the built renderer (build:renderer → copy-renderer), launchTestApp on the seeded appearance defaults. surfacePacks.spec.ts 19/19 pass; the theme-gallery visual snapshot was regenerated (14 px, sidebar seam). Change is on main, working tree only.
